Hi Hannah / Samir —

Great to meet you both yesterday. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP_v1.xlsx) and a compact 50-day transition bridge I drafted so we can align on milestones, owners, and target dates. High level: 

- Discovery & data inventory: target complete by Jun 16 (owner: Fenway IT)
- Sandbox & SSO enablement: Jun 18–23 (owner: Redwood - Rishi)
- Data ingestion and mapping: Jun 24–Jul 6 (owner: Fenway + Tessa)
- Acceptance tests & training: Jul 7–Jul 20 (owner: Fenway + Priyom)
- Go / Cutover window: Jul 21–Jul 23 (target go-live Jul 23)

Asks: 
1) Please confirm primary Fenway owners for data inventory and acceptance testing (Samir/Hannah?).
2) Can Fenway share SAML metadata and any IP allowlists for the sandbox?
3) We propose a 30-minute weekly sync (Mon or Tue mornings PT) starting week of Jun 15 — what works?

Attachments: MAP_v1.xlsx (roadmap + milestones workbook).

If the high-level dates look off for your internal calendar, tell me the hard constraints and we’ll adapt. Once we lock owners I’ll publish MAP v1.1 and set up the shared Drive.

Thanks — looking forward to kicking off.

—
Maya Srinivasan
Strategic Onboarding Manager | Redwood Inference
maya.s@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123

Thanks Maya — this looks like a solid starting point. A few items from our side: 

- We can own the data inventory; Samir will be primary.
- Acceptance testing will be owned by Clinical Ops (I’ll coordinate SME availability).
- We do need SSO (SAML) and sandbox IP allowlist — I’m attaching our security questionnaire with the immediate reqs highlighted (reqs_security.pdf).

Two constraints to note: 
1) Fenway has an internal security review week June 14–18; if the sandbox SSO cert exchange slips past the 18th we may not get completed metadata back until the following week.
2) Our clinical training windows are tight in late June (several SMEs are OOO Jun 28–30).

Can Redwood confirm who on your side will handle the SAML config and the expected artifact list we should produce? Also looping Emily from our partner Zenara who will assist with integration validation.

- Jun 18–23: Sandbox + SSO exchange (Redwood - Rishi)
- Jun 24–Jul 6: Ingestion & mapping (Fenway + Tessa)
- Jul 7–Jul 20: Acceptance tests & recorded training (Fenway + Priyom)
- Jul 21–Jul 23: Go / cutover

Weekly sync: proposing Mondays 09:00 PT starting Jun 15 (30 min). I’ll create a recurring calendar invite once you confirm.

Maya
